insert.column: SELECT to_char(lt.transaction_date::date, 'YYYY-mm-dd') AS "VALUE DATE", to_char(je.created_on_utc::date, 'YYYY-mm-dd') AS "CREATION DATE", je.transaction_id AS "TRANSACTION ID", je.entry_date AS "BOOKING DATE", ga.gl_code AS "GL ACCOUNT ID", ga.name AS "GL ACCOUNT NAME", l.account_no AS "LOAN ACCOUNT ID", rv.enum_value as "COMPROBANTE", CASE WHEN je.type_enum = 1 THEN 0 ELSE round(je.amount, 2) END AS "DEBIT AMOUNT", CASE WHEN je.type_enum = 2 THEN 0 ELSE round(je.amount, 2) END AS "CREDIT AMOUNT", u.username AS "USUARIO", ch.description AS "CHANNEL", coalesce(nt.note) AS "NOTA", pl.name AS "PRODUCT NAME" FROM acc_gl_journal_entry je left join acc_gl_account ga on ga.id = je.account_id left join m_loan_transaction lt on lt.id = je.loan_transaction_id left join m_payment_detail pd on pd.id = lt.payment_detail_id left join custom.c_channel ch on ch.hash = pd.channel_hash left join m_loan l on l.id = lt.loan_id left join m_product_loan pl on pl.id = l.product_id left join r_enum_value rv on rv.enum_id = lt.transaction_type_enum and rv.enum_name = 'loan_transaction_type_enum' left join m_appuser u on u.id = lt.created_by left join m_note nt on nt.loan_transaction_id = je.loan_transaction_id WHERE je.created_on_utc::date >= '${startDate}' AND je.created_on_utc::date <= '${endDate}' AND je.loan_transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND rv.enum_value = ANY(string_to_array('${transactionTypeLoan}', ','))

SELECT to_char(st.transaction_date::date, 'YYYY-mm-dd') AS "VALUE DATE", to_char(je.created_on_utc::date, 'YYYY-mm-dd') AS "CREATION DATE", je.transaction_id AS "TRANSACTION ID", je.entry_date AS "BOOKING DATE", ga.gl_code AS "GL ACCOUNT ID", ga.name AS "GL ACCOUNT NAME", sa.account_no AS "LOAN ACCOUNT ID", rv.enum_value as "COMPROBANTE", CASE WHEN je.type_enum = 1 THEN 0 ELSE round(je.amount, 2) END AS "DEBIT AMOUNT", CASE WHEN je.type_enum = 2 THEN 0 ELSE round(je.amount, 2) END AS "CREDIT AMOUNT", u.username AS "USUARIO", ch.description AS "CHANNEL", coalesce(nt.note) AS "NOTA", sp.name AS "PRODUCT NAME" FROM acc_gl_journal_entry je left join acc_gl_account ga on ga.id = je.account_id left join m_savings_account_transaction st on st.id = je.savings_transaction_id left join m_payment_detail pd on pd.id = st.payment_detail_id left join custom.c_channel ch on ch.hash = pd.channel_hash left join m_savings_account sa on sa.id = st.savings_account_id left join m_savings_product sp on sp.id = sa.product_id left join r_enum_value rv on rv.enum_id = st.transaction_type_enum and rv.enum_name = 'savings_transaction_type_enum' left join m_appuser u on u.id = st.created_by left join m_note nt on nt.savings_account_transaction_id = je.savings_transaction_id WHERE je.created_on_utc::date >= '${startDate}' AND je.created_on_utc::date <= '${endDate}' AND je.savings_transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND rv.enum_value = ANY(string_to_array('${transactionTypeSavings}', ','))
